sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLI OF 1979
ORDINANCE XLI OF 1979
JAMMU & KASHMIR (ADMINISTRATION OF PROPERTY) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1979
An Ordinance further to amend the Jammu & Kashmir (Administration
of Property) Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 29th August 1979]
No.F.17(1)/79-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President are hereby published for general information:-
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Jummu & Kashmir (Administration of Property) Ordinance, 1961
(III of 1961), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the President is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of the fifth day of July 1977, read with the Law (Continuance
in Force) Order, 1977 (C. M. L. A. Order No. I of 1977), and in exercise of 411
powers enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Jammu & Kashmir (Administration of Property) (Amendment) Ordinance,
1979.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Amendment of section 3, Ordinance III of 1961.-In the Jammu
& Kashmir (Administration of Property) Ordinance, 1961 (111 of 1961), in
section 3, in sub-section (3),-
(a) after clause (a), the
following new clause shall be inserted, namely
"(aa) raise the rent of any
property, if considered necessary; and
(b) in clause (b), after the word
"person", the words "who is in default in the payment of rent of
any such property for "not less than three months or is" shall be
inserted.
